correctness.rationale: An exact conditional Prüfer-word reduction gives the occupancy law. Monotone prefix coupling proves all strict order relations; crossed lower/upper support endpoints disprove both dominance directions for every remaining pair. The identity sum degrees=2(n-1) plus exchangeability gives zero covariance. The rational finite cases and rigorous exponential inequality prove the threshold for every n; 255 exact assertions over 280391 independently reconstructed trees verify finite formulas but do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: Complete first-order stochastic-order classification of the conditional global leaf count for all marked degrees and all n, including structural incomparability across every intermediate class, is a natural probability question. Zero linear covariance masks conditional distribution changes, and the exact n=9 mean crossover highlights the difference between scalar means and full order. This is not a disconnected finite-table entry or a routine bounded-degree extrapolation. The finite threshold is an auxiliary boundary, not the whole claimed advance.
